questions.question: Verify ab ((a mod m)(b mod m)) (mod m) using a=13, b=7,m=5
questions.solution_html:
• Verification of modular multiplication (6 marks)
  • LHS: 13×7=91 → 91 mod 5 = 1.
  • RHS: (13 mod 5)=3, (7 mod 5)=2 → 3×2=6 → 6 mod 5 = 1.
  • Verified.
  • Marks: Steps 4 + final 2
